messages:
maria: Heads-up team  we need a compact social plan for the Serving Inference Economics webinar. Goal: X announcement + reminder, LinkedIn multi-paragraph post, and quick engagement follow-up plan. Deliverables: 2 X copy variants, 1 LinkedIn post, hero 1200x627 PNG, 15s clip, UTMs, and SDR routing. Can we lock by EOD today?
linda: I can own X + LinkedIn. Plan to test two openers on X (stat vs benefit). Will prep 2 creatives for each.
josh: Pasting quick variants (editable):
- X A: "Cut inference costs without sacrificing latency. Join our engineers Apr 22 -> https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-econ"
- X B: "Same model, lower bill: practical serving tactics we used. Register -> https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-econ"
- LinkedIn: "Serving LLMs at scale is often an ops problem. We ran benchmarks across real workloads and will share the tactics that moved the needle. Join the webinar Apr 22. [link]"
priya: UTM scheme suggestion: `?utm_source={x|linkedin}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_econ_q2&utm_term={stat|benefit}&utm_variant={startup|enterprise}`. I'll create landing variants so we can route into different nurture flows.
sam (SDR): HubSpot list name = webinar_serving_econ_q2. Routing: round-robin to SDR - Growth. Rule: mark as high-intent if title contains "VP|Head|Director" OR company_size > 200; notify kevin and assign immediate outreach within 24h. Templates: quick auto-email + high-intent 20m ask.
leo (Design): I can do hero and 15s clip if I get final copy + one-sentence script. ETA 6 hours. Can someone drop a 1-line script?
maria: Script: "Serving LLMs: how to cut cost and keep latency. Live Apr 22. Register now." Use that for the clip.
linda: Engagement plan: after announcement, reply-thread with 2 follow-up tweets: 1) quick stat from our benchmark, 2) CTA to submit questions for the panel. We'll pin the thread.
josh: I'll pull a short benchmark stat for the thread: "prefix caching + batching reduced per-token spend by ~40% on user traces"  is that ok?
priya: Yes, use that. For tracking, please add `utm_content=stat` for the stat variant. Also create a paid ad variant with `utm_paid=1` for LinkedIn.
buffer-bot: Drafts created in Buffer queue: Apr 20 09:00 (announce), Apr 21 09:00 (reminder). Awaiting approval.
maria: Approvals: josh finalize copy by 2pm, leo deliver assets by 3pm, priya set up UTMs + landing variants by 4pm, sam finalize SDR templates by 5pm. Linda will schedule in Buffer after approvals. Ping here when ready.
sam (SDR): Also adding follow-up micro-templates here to copy:
- Auto-email: "Thanks for registering! Here's your calendar invite + key resources. Interested in a short call to discuss infra priorities?"
- High-intent: "Thanks for registering — saw your title at X. Book 20m to review your infra telemetry -> calendly link"
maria: Good. One more ask  can we capture registrant question submissions and surface top 3 to speakers 24h before? Priya can you add a hidden field and tag?
priya: Yep  I'll add `speaker_question` form field and tag registrants with `question_submitted=true` if non-empty, then export top keywords to speakers 24h prior.
linda: Once assets are live i'll run the A/B and post results summary in this thread. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maria: Thanks team  let's ship this.
